name: Enrollment Report
query:
SELECT
    student_name AS 'Student',
    course AS 'Course',
    enrollment_date AS 'Enrollment Date',
    status AS 'Status',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM `tabStudent Enrollment` t2 
     WHERE t2.course = t1.course AND t2.status = t1.status) AS 'Count per Status'
FROM `tabStudent Enrollment` t1
GROUP BY course, name;
